test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D and E are five friends. B is elder to C but is shorter in the group. C is taller to B, but younger to D. A is elder to D but not as tall as E. E is younger to C and is taller to B and D.

Which of the following sequence of their ages cannot be possible?
solution: **Given: **A, B, C, D and E are five friends. 1) C is taller to B, but younger to D. Height based → C > B Age based → D > C 2) A is elder to D but not as tall as E. 3) E is younger to C and is taller to B and D. Height based → C/E > B/D > A
